name: IEC 62443-3-3
description: System security requirements (SRs) for industrial automation and control systems relevant to zones and conduits, network segmentation, monitoring and component inventory. Zone/conduit evidence comes from Sentry's observed segmentation map (segments = observed zones, observed reachability = conduits in use). Security-level (SL) targets are set in the 62443-3-2 risk assessment, not here.

controls.title: Partition the system into zones and conduits
controls.summary: The system under consideration is partitioned into zones and conduits.
controls.rationale: The observed map shows the zones and conduits that exist on the wire; the designed partition and SL-T are documented in the 62443-3-2 assessment.
controls.attestation: Provide the zone and conduit drawing and SL-T per zone.

controls.title: Access via untrusted networks
controls.summary: Monitor and control all access to the control system via untrusted networks.
controls.rationale: Detects OT assets on public addresses and OT reachable from IT.

controls.title: Communication integrity
controls.summary: Protect the integrity of transmitted information.
controls.rationale: Flags cleartext management protocols observed on the network; integrity of industrial protocols themselves is not assessed.

controls.title: Security functionality verification
controls.summary: Verify the intended operation of security functions.
controls.rationale: Continuous passive verification that segmentation behaves as intended.

controls.title: Network segmentation
controls.summary: Logically segment control system networks from non-control system networks and segment critical networks.
controls.rationale: Observed segments and their reachability, with violations such as OT reachable from IT.

controls.title: Zone boundary protection
controls.summary: Monitor and control communications at zone boundaries.
controls.rationale: Sentry monitors observed traffic at boundaries it can see; it does not enforce (deny-by-default is a firewall function).

controls.title: General purpose person-to-person communication restrictions
controls.summary: Prevent general-purpose person-to-person messages reaching the control system.
controls.rationale: Not observable passively in a reliable way.

controls.title: Audit log accessibility
controls.summary: Authorized humans and tools can access audit logs on a read-only basis.

controls.title: Continuous monitoring
controls.summary: Continuously monitor control system security mechanisms to detect, characterize and report breaches.
controls.rationale: Sentry detectors run continuously on mirrored OT segments: lateral scanning, internet egress, behaviour drift.

controls.title: Network and security configuration settings
controls.summary: Configure network and security settings as recommended and report the current settings.

controls.title: Least functionality
controls.summary: Prohibit or restrict unnecessary functions, ports, protocols and services.
controls.rationale: Detects unnecessary exposure and insecure protocols in use.

controls.title: Control system component inventory
controls.summary: Provide the capability to report the current list of installed components and their properties.
controls.rationale: Passive OT/IoT inventory with vendor, model, protocols and firmware where observable. Device models are also matched against CVEs (see the vulnerability evidence in other packs).
